git-repository-health-auditor 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Audits Git repositories for maintainability, configuration issues, dependency risks, accidental secret exposure, and CI/CD weaknesses using read-only inspection by default.
- Provides evidence-based, reproducible findings with clear separation between confirmed observations, likely risks, and manual validation items.
- Focuses on practical checks, adapting to various project types without assuming specific languages or frameworks.
- Prioritizes user privacy and safety; does not edit files, run unapproved commands, or expose sensitive information.
- Includes limitations and scope in every report, ensuring transparency about what was (and wasn’t) inspected.
